minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  February 21, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on February 21, 2024.
Commissioner Metcalf called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐
  District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4, Commissioner
  Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

  Absent: Commissioner Olivia Alvitre – District 2

  City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

Commissioner Metcalf nominated Commissioner Lesure for Chair. Commissioner Banks
seconded and the motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Banks, Battle, and Lesure
Noes: None

Commissioner Lesure nominated Commissioner Metcalf for Vice Chair. Commissioner
Banks seconded and the motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Banks, Battle, and Lesure
Noes: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES.
It was moved by Commissioner Banks and seconded by Commissioner Metcalf that the
minutes for the Arts Commission meetings held on January 18, May 17, June 21, and
August 16, 2023 be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Banks, and Lesure
Noes: None
Abstained: Commissioner Battle

  1
   Arts Commission

 SPECIAL PRESENTATION. A quarterly report regarding the Hollywood Park/SoFi Stadium
Public Art was presented by Jason Witt, Community Engagement Director. He stated that
they have parted ways with Leslie Elwood and Maren Hassinger; SWATS is still scheduled
to be installed in a hotel space; and the Kinsey Collection is leaving at the end of March
2024. Helen Lessick requested an updated list of the funding allocations.

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects. Utility Box Refined Designs: a contract
awarded to The Creative House Gallery. The utility box priorities are four (4) in each of
the city’s four (4) Districts by four (4) artists - Rasta Asaru El, Patrick Henry, Mike Norice,
Sam Pace. It is in Phase Two, the design development with refined designs submitted on
February 1, 2024.

PUBLIC REMARKS. Greg Spero of Tiny Rooms Studios presented a video of a few events
that have taken place at his Studios. He would like to incorporate more health and
wellness nights/ programs but funding has become a challenge.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR. Commissioner Metcalf
shared potential images of a private art project consisting of a mural at Faithful Central
Bible Church located at 400 W. Florence Avenue.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:19 p.m.
